steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Modelling builds up form by adding material (clay, plasticine); carving removes material to reveal form (wood, soap, stone). | Key Fact: Casting creates multiples from a mould — plaster, latex, silicone; assemblage joins ready-made or found objects. | Key Fact: Sculpture must be considered from ALL viewpoints — walk around it, photograph from multiple angles. | Key Fact: Mass (solid volume), volume (enclosed space) and negative space (the spaces within and around) are key 3D concepts.
